### E&F Currency Merge -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### Keep the central bank company alive.
###
### Run monthly and once at game start. The `remove_company` branch is what makes
### the generic company step aside for a flavoured one: it is not chosen for the
### country up front, it is granted and then withdrawn the moment something
### better exists.

zz_ef_cm_bank_company_upkeep = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = yes
			NOT = { zz_ef_cm_has_bank_company = yes }
		}
		add_company = company_type:company_BasicBank
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			has_company = company_type:company_BasicBank
			zz_ef_cm_has_flavoured_bank_company = yes
		}
		remove_company = company_type:company_BasicBank
	}

	### The slot the central bank company occupies is given back, so it is not
	### paid for out of the country's own company limit.
	if = {
		limit = {
			zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = yes
			NOT = { has_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter }
		}
		add_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter
			NOT = { zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = yes }
		}
		remove_modifier = zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter
	}
}
